answer: Use bonded vouching: every new agent locks a refundable stake and needs endorsements from established agents, whose stakes are slashed if the newcomer proves fake. Trust builds slowly, like water carving karst, not poured basalt that sets at once, and rewards flow like nectar only to verified work. Forging 1,000 Sybils thus costs 1,000 stakes plus bribing distinct vouchers who risk their funds and standing.
